audit_method_note: Re-checking each pre-author finding against iter-1 deliverables (SPEC.md §7, design-tokens delta in proposed-design-delta.json DELTA-07/08, coredata-model.md, function_call_contract.yaml). Single-thread caveat per SPEC.md §14.3.

resolutions.evidence: DELTA-07 adds mode_chip_*_pattern tokens (disc/diamond/triangle/circle); SPEC.md §7.1 mandates color + shape + text label simultaneously. function_call_contract.yaml mode_classify return includes chip_pattern field.
SPEC.md §7.1 contrast matrix restricts user_utterance_dim to large-text only (≥32px) where 4.04 CR satisfies AA 3:1; DELTA-07 adds user_utterance_dim_high_contrast for Increase Contrast.
SPEC.md §7.5 Caption Policy: default-on, system-Live-Captions inheritance, Child Mode forced-on. L18.

SPEC.md §7.4 keyboard map (Space/Esc); §7.8 Child Mode auto-utterance FORBIDDEN; AVAudioSession ducking covered in §4.1 + SC3 catalog. function_call_contract.yaml does not include explicit pause_speech but §7.4 Cmd+. is the immediate-stop path.
SPEC.md §7.4 Keyboard Map; out_of_scope_v1 'no text channel' reconciled with WCAG 2.1.1 by adding Cmd+Enter typed-utterance a11y mode.
SPEC.md §7.4 explicit prohibited presentationOptions (.disableProcessSwitching/.disableAppleMenu/.disableForceQuit); Esc invariant 1-keypress no-confirm.
SPEC.md §7.2 VoiceOver Routing table; live region polite for ask_back, assertive for defer.
SPEC.md §7.3 + DELTA-08 add Tier 3 static + caption-only fallback with user toggle.
SPEC.md §7.6 Larger Text/Dynamic Type, caption max-width min(28em, 60vw), Child Mode +20%.
SPEC.md §7.7 + DELTA-07 _hi_contrast variants; thought silhouette → static + 'thinking…' label on Increase Contrast.
SPEC.md §7.8 Child Mode A11y Defaults; ask_back.reading_level param added in function_call_contract.yaml.
SPEC.md §7.2 state-transition audio cues + NSAccessibility announcement.

coredata-model.md adds Wonder.socraticReplyDisplayText, accessibilityNarrative, readingLevelGrade. Review UI itself remains post-MVP per out_of_scope_v1; schema reservation prevents retrofit. Not a freeze blocker.
SPEC.md §4.1 Voice Control coexistence: detection forces push-to-talk only.

new_findings_iter1.wcag_2_2_reference: 1.4.4 Resize Text — Cmd+Enter typed-utterance a11y mode is announced in §7.4 but no UI affordance is rendered to discover it
new_findings_iter1.issue: Typed-utterance a11y mode is the reconciliation of out_of_scope_v1 'no text channel' with WCAG 2.1.1. But a keyboard-only user with no a11y manual won't know Cmd+Enter exists. No on-screen affordance described.
new_findings_iter1.spec_action_required: SPEC.md §7.4: when VoiceOver is detected OR fullscreen entry happens, render a discoverable hint near caption area: 'Press Space to speak, Cmd+Enter to type a question' (KO+EN). Hint persists until first user action. Author for iter-2 if applicable; otherwise ship-acceptable as a settings-panel documented shortcut.

new_findings_iter1.issue: When a Korean past wondering is quoted verbatim mid-English sentence, VoiceOver locale auto-switching may stutter; AttributedString runs (per §10.6) needs to ALSO carry locale attribute for VO to switch voice mid-string. Not yet codified.
new_findings_iter1.spec_action_required: SPEC.md §10.4 (or §7.2): add NSAttributedString.Key.languageIdentifier per-run mandate; Wonder.socraticReplyDisplayText is rendered as AttributedString with per-run locale tags.

approval_rationale: All 7 pre-author blockings resolved; 4 of 5 highs resolved; 2 of 3 mediums resolved (1 deferred to post-MVP with schema reservation, acceptable); 1 low resolved. 2 new findings emerged at iter-1 (1 high, 1 medium) — high is non-blocking ship-acceptable but cleaner with iter-2 pass; medium is also non-blocking. Recommend ESCAPE EARLY (single iter-2 spot fix on SC1-NEW-001 if budget allows) OR FREEZE if budget exhausted.
